fact: Mali's Law no. 2016-012 of 6 May 2016 on electronic transactions, exchanges and services is stated to derive from the transposition of the ECOWAS Supplementary Act A/SA.2/01/10 on electronic transactions.
title: La loi malienne n° 2016-012 du 6 mai 2016 relative aux transactions, échanges et services électroniques
publisher: Pr Bréhima Kamena, Université des Sciences Juridiques et Politiques de Bamako
